guideline: prefer composition and clear state ownership
stabilize expensive subtree boundaries only after profiling

do: use schema or form library only when complexity justifies it
button means button and label controls
dont: clickable div with manual keyboard patches

guideline: use effects to synchronize external systems
do: keep pure derivation out of effects
dont: effect chains that compute render state
array index key for mutable list

guideline: keep context scope aligned to consumers
dont: put all app state in one provider

guideline: provide error boundary where UI subtree can recover
do: show retry or safe fallback with cause context
dont: blank screen or catch everything globally
